dedupe_keys.name: output data for thames et al climate sensitivity of agricultural water demand

description: Alexander Thames at Pennsylvania State University publishes generated precipitation, temperature and frost-date files for use in the StateCU consumptive-use model. The January 2026 release accompanies a study of climate sensitivity and growing-season control in the Colorado portion of the Upper Colorado River Basin. Its inventory includes NOAA-derived and CMIP6-labelled scenario archives, a projected-weather CSV and figures, free under CC BY 4.0. These synthetic weather outputs can drive irrigation-demand experiments while preserving the distinction between observations and generated scenarios. The related EGU abstract describes a multisite copula-based generator and regional consumptive-use analysis. Exact scenario periods, member definitions and field units remain unknown from the landing page. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this output collection. It is distinct from the separately deposited climate inputs. Scenario plausibility, uncertainty and StateCU compatibility were not independently tested.
